app.name: Shellvane
cli.usage:
Usage: {{.Command}} <command>

Commands:
  list                      List saved hosts
  connect <host|user@host>  Open a host in the running Shellvane
  connect --ssh <host>      Run the system's ssh for a saved host in this terminal
  open <ssh://… | sftp://…> Open a link in the running Shellvane
  tunnel [list]             List tunnels and their state
  tunnel up|down <name>     Start or stop a tunnel in the running Shellvane
  import ssh-config [file]  Import ~/.ssh/config (or file)
  version                   Print version information
  help                      Show this help
cli.imported: Imported {{.Hosts}} hosts and {{.Tunnels}} tunnels; {{.Skipped}} already present; {{.Warnings}} items not imported.
cli.errors.control.notRunning: Shellvane is not running: start it first, or use “{{.Command}} connect --ssh <host>”.
cli.errors.url.invalid: Not a valid ssh:// or sftp:// link: {{.url}}
